scope: fpt-portal-v2-worker shared production entrypoint and path-scoped 11+ Practice bridge preservation
precedence: This override supersedes conflicting statements about the production fpt-portal-v2-worker top-level entrypoint and quiz-bridge preservation only. All non-conflicting Portal V2 and Replace Resource authority remains binding.

incident.rootCause: The shared production deployment script correctly derived worker/wrangler.toml, but that canonical config still named index-admin-tools.js. A later Admin/Replace Resource deployment therefore replaced the previously deployed index-step10-quiz-bridge.js outer wrapper. The bridge source itself delegates non-quiz traffic to index-admin-tools.js, so the capabilities should have been composed rather than alternated.
incident.studentSymptom: A valid public Student Worker launch can reach the Quiz hostname, but Quiz server-to-server redemption against /api/v1/quiz-bridge/redeem cannot succeed when the shared Worker is deployed without the bridge wrapper; the Quiz then shows its invalid-link fail-closed page.

publicQuizRuntimeBoundary.l2l3Authority: The canonical 11+ Practice production authority records L2 actual-release-only access, L3 full-L2 inheritance plus released L3 gates, and stable cross-level history. Do not infer the live Quiz runtime from the stale default-branch standalone source.

requiredProductionTopology.delegationInvariant: The quiz bridge owns only its exact compatibility paths and delegates every other request to Admin Tools unchanged.
requiredProductionTopology.futureDeployInvariant: Any ordinary shared Worker production deploy must preserve the composed quiz bridge and Admin/Trial/protected-view/Replace Resource capabilities in the same bundle. Deploying index-admin-tools.js alone is prohibited unless a separately authorised rollback explicitly intends to remove the bridge.

repositoryStaticEvidence.result: All triggered non-production/static compatibility gates for the composed shared Worker repair and the duplicate-deploy retirement completed successfully.

productionEvidence.legacyGateCFailureInterpretation: The historical Gate C job first redeployed the same canonical composed Worker and passed existing Portal regression checks. It then failed because it still asserted obsolete /api/v1/student/quiz/eligibility and /api/v1/student/quiz/launch routes on the shared Worker. Current authority assigns public launch to the Student Worker /api/v2 routes, so this is a stale workflow assertion, not evidence that the composed production bridge failed.

stopConditions: Incident is closed PASS after owner browser verification. Reopen only if the invalid-link failure is reproduced or a future shared Worker deployment violates the composed entrypoint invariant.
If a future guarded production workflow fails, retain or restore its captured pre-deploy Worker version and diagnose before another mutation.
